titles.title: End the Fed’s Big Bank Bailout Act
End the Fed’s Big Bank Bailout Act
A bill to amend the Federal Reserve Act to prohibit earnings on balances maintained at a Federal Reserve bank by or on behalf of a depository institution.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs. Hearings held.

committee.name: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
Senate Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

bill.summary:
End the Fed’s Big Bank Bailout Act
This bill prohibits a Federal Reserve bank from paying earnings on balances maintained at a Federal Reserve bank by or on behalf of a depository institution. Currently, such balances may receive earnings at least once each quarter at a rate not to exceed the general level of short-term interest rates.
